title: NASA-UAP-D1, Apollo 12 Transcript, 1969
doc_notes: This document is an excerpt from the Apollo 12 Technical Air-to-Ground Voice Transcription containing reports of unidentified visual phenomena by the flight crew.

incidents.summary: Astronaut Alan Bean observed particles and flashes of light sailing off in space while looking through the Alignment Optical Telescope.
incidents.quote: It's coming from behind me, the left, and they're just sailing off in space.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed floating debris outside the lunar module, initially thought to be illuminated by the tracking light, but later suspected the light had burned out.
incidents.quote: little bits and pieces floating along with us and we could tell that the tracking light was flashing on them.
